simple.summary: עַצְלָה (ʻatslâh) means (as abstractly) indolence First listed occurrence: Eccl 10 18.

definitions.full: H6103. atslah עֵצְלָה noun feminine sluggishness ; — ׳י Prov 19:15 ; dual intensive עֲצַלְתַּיִם Eccl 10:18 double (i.e. great) sluggishness (so Thes De and others; read then perhaps עֵצְלָתַיִם ; > from עָצֵל a sluggish pair , i.e. hands Ew and others), but improbable; || יָדַיִם שִׁפְלוּת , whence Bi conjectures עֵצְלוּת , Siegf יָדַיִם עֵצְלַת .
